_comment: Admin Dashboard default layout (factory seed). This is the bundled, always-tracked default a fresh admin — or a 'reset to default' — starts from. An admin can override it at runtime via the dashboard's 'Save as default' button, which writes data/config/dashboard-default.json (gitignored); that override wins over this file. See app/util/paths.dashboard_default_path() and ui/main-panel/app/dashboard/server.py. Each card: id (stable), type (a card-plugin folder id under ui/main-panel/app/dashboard/cards/<id>/, or a shell framework key: metric_chart | custom | add_card), and grid cells x,y,w,h (12 columns wide, 88px rows). The full-width metric_chart also carries series (enabled line/bar ids) and range (time window).
